notes.title: v0.9.13 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🐸💚

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807727/58eb00aec42e2f8f1a995914041828945b2dc1b2.gif
Once again I've come with a new patch to fix various bugs! With this most of the irks are gone and you should be able to experience the game at its smoothest!

Here's the patch notes:

v0.9.13

 Made latching on autoaim targets always possible even with autoaim turned off.
 Fixed load scene bug when resetting at the same time as death.
 Speedrun UI now shows on level select too.
 Made collider for Elena shield platforms thicker.
 Fixed Neon Beebz hat's outline in level select.
 Made Jake show the correct version of the Android Replica helmet in level select.
 Fixed regular time trial time in The Lab.
 Fixed Cybeelzebub death particle texture.


As always, thank you very much for your love and support, and I hope you have lots of fun! 🐸💚

notes.title: v0.9.12 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 🐸💚
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807727/f90a9ff35d2e10e8377d87dc19109b33102d6580.gif

First of all, thank you for all of the support and kind words! The last couple of days have been a blur!
As things start to calm down a bit, a new patch comes to fix some issues in the game.

Here's the patch notes for the last few patches - the current version is the x.12 variant:

v0.9.11

 Fixed air-latching after bonk bug.
 Tweaked render distance in Oldstone Stronghold side section so it doesn't cut geometry in two players mode.
 Fixed swap buttons option for new moves.
 Fixed tossed jar zipline bug.
 Adjusted Elena point master time trial time.
 Fixed dialogue voice clips in CN language.
 Removed coins clipping in Mossy Castle Wall.
 Adjusted time trial times for Yushi's First Shrine.
 Fixed hitbox of fire rings in Mechaster fight.


v0.9.12

 Made Cybeelzebub rocks spawn in correct orientation.
 Made Cybeelzebub missiles stop angular velocity when grabbed.
 Made cybeelzebub missiles explode if thrown downwards to the ground.
 Fixed interaction between missiles and energy waves.
 Adjusted swing bar hitbox so it works better without autoaim.
 Tweaked chest hitbox so it works better with autoaim turned off.
 Made invisible blocks not grappable.
 Made exit level button in pause menu work even in the first level. If the first level hasn't been finished it returns to main menu instead.


Again, thank you very much, and I hope you have lots of fun! 🐸💚

notes.title: Release Date + New Trailer @ Guerilla Collective!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 🐸💙
We come with an announcement we're very happy to make!

[previewyoutube=HQLAGXlPuew;full][/previewyoutube]

As you just saw: ✨Frogun Encore will release June 25th!✨
As part of this year's Guerilla Collective (and our publisher's showcase within such), we've revealed not only a brand new trailer, but also a RELEASE DATE!

In less than a month, you'll be able to go around the world with Renata and Frogun, and all their friends, using new moves and facing new challenges!

Thank you for sticking with us during development. I hope you'll enjoy this new adventure!

Additionally, you can learn more about the publisher showcase the game is participating in (along with the other games being announced) over Top Hat's publisher page here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/tophatstudios
